theorems.name: Submission.ts_fv_compact_variation_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → Ambient n ℓ → Ambient n ℓ) (ε : ℝ) (K : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), IsCompactVariation φ ε K → ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun y ↦ deriv (fun t ↦ φ t y) 0) ∧ (∀ y ∉ K, fderiv ℝ (fun y ↦ deriv (fun t ↦ φ t y) 0) y = 0) ∧ (∀ t ∈ Ioo (-ε) ε, (∃ L : NNReal, LipschitzWith L (φ t)) ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 (φ t)) ∧ ∃ δ B : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ < ε ∧ ∃ Λ' : ℝ → Ambient n ℓ → (Ambient n ℓ →L[ℝ] Ambient n ℓ), ∀ x, Λ' 0 x = fderiv ℝ (fun y ↦ deriv (fun t ↦ φ t y) 0) x ∧ ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-δ) δ, HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ fderiv ℝ (φ s) x) (Λ' t x) t ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ (φ t) x‖ ≤ B ∧ ‖Λ' t x‖ ≤ B ∧ ∀ v, ‖v‖ ≤ B * ‖fderiv ℝ (φ t) x v‖
